hints.title: Left Preference Downward Slope
hints.text: Simulate each droplet independently. First search to the left of k for the leftmost strictly lowest position without climbing over higher terrain.

hints.title: Right Preference Secondary Slope
hints.text: If no lower resting spot exists to the left, search to the right of k for the rightmost strictly lowest position.

hints.title: In-Place Increment
hints.text: If either left or right yields a strictly lower elevation, increment that lowest position by one; otherwise increment index k directly. Repeat for all droplets.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Simulation per droplet scanning slopes leftwards then rightwards.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Global physics simulations overcomplicate the deterministic rules specified for single droplet flow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place terrain modifications require O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Stop scanning when terrain rises (heights[i] > heights[i+1]) and fall back to rightward scan.
